extName.description: Extension name; the product name, never translated.

extDescription.message: הורדת הקלטות וקבצי PDF מהדף שבו אתה צופה ישירות ל-FastStudy.
extDescription.description: Extension description in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions.

statusLoading.description: Popup status while it reads the page.

statusYoutube.description: Popup status on a YouTube page.

statusPdf.description: Popup status on a PDF page.

statusNothing.message: לא נמצא וידאו או PDF בדף הזה. הפעל את הווידאו לכמה שניות ופתח שוב.
statusNothing.description: Popup status when nothing was captured.

statusAppClosed.description: FastStudy is installed but not running, so there is no server to reach.

statusOffline.message: אין חיבור ל-FastStudy. פתח את אפליקציית FastStudy ונסה שוב.
statusOffline.description: The local FastStudy server is not answering.

labelVideoLink.description: Label of the YouTube page URL field.

labelFile.description: Label of the received file's name box.

labelPdf.description: Label of the PDF URL field.

labelName.description: Label of the lecture/recitation name field.

placeholderLecture.description: Placeholder of the name field for a lecture.

placeholderRecitation.description: Placeholder of the name field for a recitation.

dirLecture.description: Suggested folder name prefix for a course with no lectures yet; lands on disk.

dirRecitation.description: Suggested folder name prefix for a course with no recitations yet; lands on disk.

btnDownloading.description: The download button while the request is in flight.

doneVideo.message: מוריד אל $TARGET$. אפשר לעקוב בהורדות ב-FastStudy.
doneVideo.description: Shown once the server accepted a video download.

donePdf.description: Shown once the PDF was stored.

errMissingTarget.description: Submit with an empty course or name.

errStart.description: Headline when the server refused a download; its own text shows beneath.

errPdfFetch.message: לא ניתן לקרוא את ה-PDF מהדף הזה.
errPdfFetch.description: Headline when the popup could not fetch the PDF itself.

errPdfStore.description: Headline when the server refused the PDF; its own text shows beneath.

errHlsExpired.message: תוקף הסשן של הסרטון בדף הזה פג. רענן את הדף, הפעל את הסרטון למספר שניות ואז פתח שוב.
errHlsExpired.description: Headline when every captured stream playlist was refused, so the page's session is over; the server's text shows beneath.

errHlsStreams.message: לא ניתן לבדוק את הזרמים בדף הזה.
errHlsStreams.description: Headline when the server failed to classify the captured stream playlists; its own text shows beneath.

labelNoAudio.description: Marker on a stream that carries no audio track.

labelMode.description: Accessible name of the App lecture / General video switch.

modeApp.description: Mode switch: save into a course in FastStudy.

modeGeneral.description: Mode switch: save as a plain file in a folder on the computer.

labelFileName.description: Label of the file name field in General video mode.

placeholderFileName.description: Placeholder of the file name field.

labelFolder.description: Label of the read-only folder the file is saved into.

btnChooseFolder.description: Opens the folder picker in the FastStudy app window.

pickInApp.message: בחר את התיקייה בחלון של FastStudy ופתח את זה שוב.
pickInApp.description: Shown once the app window was asked to open its folder picker.

errOpenAppWindow.message: פתח את חלון האפליקציה FastStudy ונסה שוב.
errOpenAppWindow.description: No FastStudy window is open to show the folder picker.

errChooseFolder.message: לא ניתן לפתוח את בחירת התיקייה.
errChooseFolder.description: Headline when the server refused the folder pick; its own text shows beneath.

errMissingFileName.description: Submit in General video mode with an empty file name.

doneGeneralVideo.message: מוריד את $FILE$ אל $FOLDER$. אפשר לעקוב בהורדות ב-FastStudy.
doneGeneralVideo.description: Shown once the server accepted a General video download.

doneGeneralPdf.description: Shown once the PDF was saved into the folder.

progressPdfDownloading.description: Headline while the worker fetches the PDF; the sizes read so far.

progressPdfUploading.description: Headline while the worker hands the PDF to FastStudy.

errPdfInterrupted.description: Headline when the browser stopped the extension mid-download.

menuSend.description: Right-click menu item on a file link.

noticeReceived.message: הקובץ התקבל ($TYPE$). בחר לאן לשמור אותו.
noticeReceived.description: Green notice above the file name box once a right-clicked link resolved to a supported file

progressFileResolving.description: Neutral line while the worker reads the link's headers.

progressFileDownloading.description: Headline while the worker fetches the received file; the sizes read so far.

progressFileUploading.description: Headline while the worker hands the received file to FastStudy.

errFileFetch.message: לא ניתן לקרוא את הקובץ מהאתר.
errFileFetch.description: Headline when the worker could not fetch the received file; the reason shows beneath.

errFileStore.description: Headline when the server refused the received file; its own text shows beneath.

errFileHtml.message: הקישור הזה פותח דף אינטרנט ולא קובץ. אם החיבור לאתר פג, התחבר אליו מחדש ונסה שוב.
errFileHtml.description: Red notice: the link answered with an HTML page.

errFileType.description: Red notice: the file's type is not a supported material; its name shows beneath.

errFileHttp.description: Red notice: the link answered with an error status; the status shows beneath.

errFileUnreachable.description: Red notice: the request for the link failed; the reason shows beneath.
